summary: Ellos Holding AB (publ) operates as an online retailer of fashion and home interior products in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. The company offers a range of products, such as curtains, furniture, bed textiles, décor, and carpets. It operates an online platform, integrating group-wide functions such as sourcing, logistics, data analytics, data-driven digital marketing, payment solutions, and customer service. The company operates its online stores under the brand names Ellos, Jotex, Homeroom, and the payment brand Elpy. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Borås, Sweden.
